## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Mutating team operations require org ownership (reqOrgOwnership middleware) | authorization | User is not site admin AND not org owner |
| Team name 'new' is reserved and cannot be used | validation | name == 'new' |
| Team name must be unique within organization (case-insensitive) | validation | Team with same lower_name exists in same org_id |
| Admin teams automatically get all unit types with admin access | business_logic | team.AccessMode >= perm.AccessModeAdmin |
| Owner team cannot have CanCreateOrgRepo set to false | business_logic | team.IsOwnerTeam() AND form.CanCreateOrgRepo != nil |
| Owner team permission and includes_all_repositories cannot be changed | business_logic | team.IsOwnerTeam() |

### Error Paths

- **team not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **not org owner** → reqOrgOwnership → 404
- **duplicate team name** → org_service.UpdateTeam → 500
